title: Healthy Habits for Life: Sleep, Movement, Nutrition, Screens
summary: Habits now shape future health. 9-11 hours of sleep, 60 minutes of movement daily, real food (less sugar/processed), screens <2 hours/day, no screens in the bedroom. Parents: be the model—your child watches, not just listens.
try_this: This week: a family challenge—walk 30 minutes daily together, screen-free dinner, sleep before 10 p.m. Record: how was your mood/energy?
reflection_prompts: Which habit is the hardest for the family?
What improvement did they notice after a week?

review_defects.english: your child watches, not just listens
review_defects.why: The Arabic says the child watches and does not listen (absolute negation). The English softens this to 'not just listens', implying they do listen but watching is more important. The meaning is altered.
